answer: The strongest sybil defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times honest epochs, so a new identity climbs like a vine on a wharf pillar, one ring per season. Each epoch, agents stake deposits audited on past deals; dishonesty burns the stake and resets the age multiplier. An attacker spawning thousands of fake cipher-like accounts gains little, since influence accrues over years of honesty, not creation volume. Attack cost is time plus forfeited stakes, making fakery irrational while honest agents compound weight.
